name: Cuboid Manipulation Robot Skills
description: Parametric skills for picking and placing cuboids on an Isaac Sim table with a UR5 + Robotiq gripper. The underlying robot controller is the `program_executor` ROS 2 node in ur5_curobo_control. Each skill below maps to a program file in ur5_curobo_control/programs/ and is invoked via the standard load-then-execute sequence: (1) set ROS 2 parameters `program_file` and `program_args` on the executor node, (2) call service `/program_executor/load_program` (std_srvs/Trigger), (3) call service `/program_executor/execute_program` (std_srvs/Trigger). Live cuboid pick poses are written into ur5_curobo_control/config/named_positions.txt by the Isaac Sim extension on every scene setup, so `cuboid_red`, `cuboid_green`, etc. are resolvable at execution time.

parameters.program_file: string — absolute path or basename of the .prog file under ur5_curobo_control/programs/

skills.name: Move to Named Position
skills.description: Move the robot to a specific named joint configuration or position (e.g. Home, safe, a cuboid location).

name.description: The name of the position to move to

skills.name: Pick Cuboid
skills.description: Approach the named cuboid from 15 cm above its live pose, descend, close the gripper, and retreat to the `safe` pose (defaults to Home). Cuboid poses are populated in named_positions.txt by the Isaac Sim extension.

cuboid.description: Cuboid id to pick; must match a pose name in named_positions.txt

skills.name: Place Cuboid
skills.description: While holding a cuboid, descend to the named destination pose, open the gripper, and retreat to the `safe` pose.

destination.description: Named destination pose (e.g., blue_basket_drop_position, or any pose id defined in task_profile.drop_zones)

skills.name: Pick and Place Cuboid
skills.description: One-shot pick-and-place: pick the named cuboid from the table and release it at the named destination, transiting via the safe pose.

skills.name: Stop Program
skills.description: Halt the currently executing program immediately.

skills.name: Wait
skills.description: Wait for a specified duration or until the human signals readiness.
